title: 銀行與金融
description: 銀行業務與金融相關用語

sentences.en: I would like to open a savings account that offers competitive interest rates and has no monthly maintenance fees.
sentences.zh: 我想開一個利率有競爭力且沒有月維護費的儲蓄帳戶。

sentences.en: The mortgage application, which requires extensive documentation, typically takes between two and four weeks to process.
sentences.zh: 抵押貸款申請需要大量文件，通常需要兩到四週的處理時間。

sentences.en: Could you explain the penalties associated with early withdrawal from a fixed-term deposit account?
sentences.zh: 您能解釋一下從定期存款帳戶提前提款的相關罰款嗎？

sentences.en: Having noticed an unauthorized transaction on my statement, I need to file a dispute immediately to protect my account.
sentences.zh: 我注意到帳單上有一筆未經授權的交易，需要立即提出爭議以保護我的帳戶。

sentences.en: The financial advisor recommended diversifying my portfolio by investing in both domestic and international index funds.
sentences.zh: 理財顧問建議我透過投資國內和國際指數基金來分散投資組合。

sentences.en: To qualify for the premium credit card, which comes with travel insurance, you must maintain a minimum annual income.
sentences.zh: 要申請附帶旅行保險的高級信用卡，您必須維持最低年收入。

sentences.en: I am writing to request a detailed breakdown of all fees charged to my account over the past six months.
sentences.zh: 我寫信要求提供過去六個月內對我帳戶收取的所有費用的詳細明細。

sentences.en: The wire transfer, initiated on Monday morning, should arrive in the recipient's account within three business days.
sentences.zh: 週一早上發起的電匯應在三個工作日內到達收款人帳戶。

sentences.en: Before approving the loan, the bank will conduct a thorough credit check to assess your repayment capacity.
sentences.zh: 在批准貸款之前，銀行將進行全面的信用檢查以評估您的還款能力。

sentences.en: Since my debit card was compromised during an overseas trip, I urgently need a replacement card issued to my current address.
sentences.zh: 由於我的借記卡在海外旅行期間被盜用，我急需將補發卡寄到我目前的地址。

sentences.en: The interest rate on variable-rate mortgages, unlike fixed-rate ones, fluctuates according to market conditions.
sentences.zh: 浮動利率抵押貸款的利率與固定利率不同，會隨市場狀況波動。

sentences.en: I would appreciate it if you could waive the overdraft fee, considering that this is my first occurrence in five years.
sentences.zh: 考慮到這是我五年來第一次發生這種情況，如果您能免除透支費用，我將非常感激。

sentences.en: To set up automatic bill payments, which will help you avoid late fees, please complete this authorization form.
sentences.zh: 要設定自動繳費（這將幫助您避免逾期費用），請填寫此授權表格。

sentences.en: The bank has recently introduced a mobile application that allows customers to deposit checks by simply taking a photograph.
sentences.zh: 銀行最近推出了一款手機應用程式，讓客戶只需拍照即可存入支票。

sentences.en: After reviewing your financial history, we are pleased to inform you that your credit limit has been increased.
sentences.zh: 在審查您的財務歷史後，我們很高興通知您，您的信用額度已被提高。

sentences.en: The compound interest earned on your certificate of deposit will be calculated quarterly and credited to your account automatically.
sentences.zh: 您定存證書所賺取的複利將按季度計算並自動存入您的帳戶。

sentences.en: I need to update my beneficiary information because my circumstances have changed significantly since I opened this account.
sentences.zh: 我需要更新我的受益人資訊，因為自從開戶以來，我的情況已經發生了重大變化。

sentences.en: The foreign exchange rate, which is updated every hour, determines how much you will receive in the converted currency.
sentences.zh: 每小時更新一次的外匯匯率決定了您將收到多少兌換貨幣。

sentences.en: In order to protect your identity, the bank requires two forms of government-issued identification for large cash withdrawals.
sentences.zh: 為了保護您的身份，銀行要求大額現金提款時出示兩種政府發行的身份證明文件。

sentences.en: Having been a loyal customer for over a decade, I believe I qualify for the exclusive platinum membership benefits.
sentences.zh: 作為十多年的忠實客戶，我相信我有資格享受專屬白金會員福利。

sentences.en: The student loan repayment plan, designed for recent graduates, offers lower monthly payments during the initial grace period.
sentences.zh: 專為應屆畢業生設計的學生貸款還款計劃在最初的寬限期內提供較低的月付款。

sentences.en: Please be advised that your account will be temporarily frozen if suspicious activity is detected by our fraud prevention system.
sentences.zh: 請注意，如果我們的詐騙防範系統偵測到可疑活動，您的帳戶將被暫時凍結。

sentences.en: The investment portfolio I selected, which includes a mix of stocks and bonds, has generated a steady return over the past year.
sentences.zh: 我選擇的投資組合包括股票和債券的混合，在過去一年中產生了穩定的回報。

sentences.en: Before transferring funds internationally, you should be aware of the conversion fees and processing times involved in such transactions.
sentences.zh: 在進行國際轉帳之前，您應該了解此類交易所涉及的兌換費用和處理時間。

sentences.en: The bank manager, who has been extremely helpful throughout this process, assured me that the issue would be resolved promptly.
sentences.zh: 在整個過程中一直非常樂於助人的銀行經理向我保證問題會盡快解決。

sentences.en: I am considering refinancing my home loan to take advantage of the historically low interest rates currently available.
sentences.zh: 我正在考慮為我的房屋貸款進行再融資，以利用目前歷史性的低利率。

sentences.en: The automated teller machine, located at the corner of Fifth Avenue, dispenses both local currency and US dollars.
sentences.zh: 位於第五大道轉角的自動提款機可以提取當地貨幣和美元。

sentences.en: To avoid potential identity theft, we strongly recommend enabling two-factor authentication on all your online banking accounts.
sentences.zh: 為避免潛在的身份盜竊，我們強烈建議在所有網路銀行帳戶上啟用雙重驗證。

sentences.en: The quarterly financial statement, which details all deposits and withdrawals, will be mailed to your registered address next week.
sentences.zh: 詳列所有存款和提款的季度財務報表將於下週郵寄至您的登記地址。

sentences.en: Provided that you maintain the minimum balance requirement, all transaction fees associated with this premium account will be waived.
sentences.zh: 只要您維持最低餘額要求，與此高級帳戶相關的所有交易費用都將被免除。
